faqs.q: Why is my competitor outranking me in Portugal?
faqs.a: Usually stronger reviews, better Portuguese-language relevance, or more local authority. Lisbon is the most competitive market; the Algarve is seasonal. I check all three factors in the audit and tell you which one is actually costing you.

faqs.q: Do I need a Google Business Profile in Portugal?
faqs.a: Yes. It is free and often the first thing customers see. Portuguese customers check reviews and photos closely, so a complete, active profile beats a beautiful website with an empty one.

faqs.q: How long does SEO take to work in Portugal?
faqs.a: Most businesses see early movement in 2 to 3 months and meaningful results in 4 to 6 months. Tourism businesses should start well before the season: work done in winter ranks by summer.

faqs.q: How much should a business in Portugal budget for SEO?
faqs.a: It depends on your market, but serious SEO is a monthly commitment, not a one-off. My pricing is public, and every engagement starts with a free audit so you know what the budget does first.
